services.name: Tradewind Sails
services.desc: Pure exhilaration with the wind and waves off Waikiki as your engine. About the cruise Kiss the tour bus goodbye. This is the ride of your life. Our crew will be serving up Mai Tai cocktails, beer, champagne, wine, juices, and soft drinks, along with plenty of personality. Get ready to have fun and get wet. (Or not, depending where you sit.) And make friends from all over the world. It’s the #1 sail around…at least according to anyone who’s ever been on it. Our crew will be serving up: Mai Tai’s, Wine, Pogmosa, and Champagne for $6 each Beer & Spritzers for $5 each Juices, Soft Drinks & Water for $3 each. services.name: Afternoon Delite Sail
services.desc: Our Newest Sail! Pure exhilaration with the wind and waves off Waikiki as your engine. About the cruise Sail on our Maita`i Afternoon Delite Sail which departs at 3:00pm. Set sail from Waikiki Beach and enjoy the panoramic views of our island and enjoy our “Delite”ful friends that we encounter such as whales (seasonal), dolphins, turtles and flying fish to name a few. Get ready to have fun and get wet. (Or not, depending where you sit.) And make friends from all over the world. It’s our newest sail!! services.name: Sunset Mai Tai Sail
services.desc: This is one Mai Tai you’ll remember, but bring your camera anyway! About the cruise Open Bar - Beverages include Mai Tais, beer, wine, champagne, juices, and soft drinks. You’ll board barefoot from Waikiki Beach, then sail into the sunset sipping a fruity Mai Tai. We’ll also be serving beer, wine, juices and soft drinks if you prefer. And, of course, plenty of water. This romantic journey offers golden views of Diamond Head, Waikiki and Honolulu’s cityscape, as the sun paints the sky and melts into the sea. Duration 90 Minutes Large Groups For parties of 11 or more, please call us at 808-922-5665 to

services.desc: About the cruise Open Bar - Beverages include Mai Tais, beer, wine, champagne, juices, and soft drinks. If you enjoyed our other sails, you'll love this one. A 90-minute expedition, complete with the usual beverage service and charming captain and crew that you won't forget. services.desc: Ring in the new year on the Maitaʻi Catamaran! About the cruise Open Bar - Beverages include Mai Tais, beer, wine, champagne, juices, and soft drinks. What better way to welcome the New Year than on board the Maita’i Catamaran. In with the new, out with the old….it’s time to celebrate on our New Year’s Eve Sail! Lots of music, fun and festivities is the name of the game on this ninety minute sail. The best way to welcome new beginnings and the New Year! Book early!
